description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named SetExam.aspx, managing navigation for an online examination system. It contains event handlers for button clicks, which transfer users to different pages such as admin panel, leaderboard, theory set, MCQ set, and login page.

classes.name: SetExam1
classes.description: Partial class handling the server-side logic for the SetExam.aspx page, primarily managing navigation through button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for profile button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: theoryB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Theory Set page.

methods.name: mcqB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the MCQ Set page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Login Page, effectively logging out the user.
